```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Pursuing piecemeal reforms will not be sufficient to halt the rise of fascism or avert ecological collapse.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Seizing power within a liberal state framework will not be sufficient to halt the rise of fascism or avert ecological collapse.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The whole of the working class must be organized and brought consciously and deliberately into self-governance.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism can no more be ‘persuaded’ to limit growth than a human being can be ‘persuaded’ to stop breathing.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Attempts to ‘green’ capitalism, to make it ‘ecological’, are doomed by the very nature of the system as a system of endless growth.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s involvement in electoral politics should counter state hegemony.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s involvement in electoral politics should foster revolutionary opportunities for the working class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Socialists should hold no illusions that the levers of state power can simply be put to work for socialist ends.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Strategic engagement with the state, including electoral politics, can help create revolutionary opportunities for the working class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Socialists who operate within the capitalist state are working behind enemy lines.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"DSA’s participation in bourgeois democracy poses the constant risk of co-optation and recuperation.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
